---
title: "Colocalization integration: CAD sQTL junctions mapped to long-read and GENCODE transcripts"
output: html_document
---

## Purpose

This script turns the CAD GWAS–VSMC sQTL colocalization results into the junction table that
every downstream analysis in this repository builds on. Each colocalized LeafCutter junction is
first assigned an effect direction relative to the CAD risk allele, because the sQTL slope is
reported per alternative allele and therefore only equals the risk-allele effect when the risk
allele happens to be the alternative allele; the risk allele is taken from the Aragam et al.
(2022) CAD GWAS summary statistics, with an LD-proxy lookup for lead variants that are not
themselves reported. Each junction is then matched by exact intron coordinates to the intron set
of the VSMC long-read transcript models and to the intron set of GENCODE v38, which yields the
annotation status (both, GENCODE only, long-read only, neither) used throughout the manuscript.
Finally, the colocalization, LD-expansion and VEP/SpliceAI counts quoted in the text and shown in
Fig. 1g are derived from the Supplementary Tables workbook so that the reported numbers and the
published tables share one source.

## Manuscript outputs produced

- Numbers in Results and Methods: 355 distinct colocalized junctions, 168 sGenes, 304 lead sQTL
  variants, 1,534 variants shared between the sQTL and CAD GWAS LD sets, 115 variants returning
  SpliceAI or VEP splicing evidence (`colocalization_number_summary.csv`).
- Variant-level SpliceAI/VEP table that `10_figure_and_table_generation.Rmd` plots as Fig. 1g
  (`variant_level_vep_spliceai.csv`).
- Methods, "Colocalization with CAD GWAS" and "Mapping CAD sQTL junctions to transcripts and
  proteins".

## Inputs

- `F_COLOC_WITH_SLOPES` — colocalized sQTL junctions (one row per junction × condition) with the
  lead sQTL variant, sQTL slope, reference/alternative alleles and nominal statistics.
- `F_ARAGAM_SNP_SUBSET` — rows of the Aragam et al. (2022) summary statistics (GWAS Catalog
  GCST90132314) for the lead sQTL variants and their LD proxies.
- `F_CAD_SQTL_SNPS_LD` — HaploReg v4.2 LD expansion (r² ≥ 0.8) of the lead sQTL variants.
- `F_SMC_INTRON_COORDS` — intron coordinates of every VSMC long-read transcript model.
- `F_GENCODE_V38_INTRONS` — intron coordinates of every GENCODE v38 transcript.
- `F_SUPP_TABLES_XLSX` — the Supplementary Tables workbook (sheets S1–S5).

## Outputs

- `OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED` — the integrated junction table; read by scripts 02, 03, 04, 05 and 10.
- `OUT_VARIANT_VEP_SPLICEAI` — one row per annotated variant with its maximum SpliceAI delta
  score and VEP consequences; read by script 10 (Fig. 1g).
- `OUT_COLOC_NUMBER_SUMMARY` — the colocalization, LD-expansion and annotation counts.

## Run order

First script in the chain; it depends only on files in `data/`.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("config.R")
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

require_files(F_COLOC_WITH_SLOPES, F_ARAGAM_SNP_SUBSET, F_CAD_SQTL_SNPS_LD,
              F_SMC_INTRON_COORDS, F_GENCODE_V38_INTRONS, F_SUPP_TABLES_XLSX)
ensure_dir(RES_01)
```

# 1. Colocalized junctions

The colocalization results identify each junction by a LeafCutter `cluster_id` of the form
`chr:intron_start:intron_end:clu_N_strand:ENSG`. The `clu_N` label is assigned per LeafCutter
run and is therefore not comparable between conditions, so all matching in this repository uses
the genomic coordinates (`chr:start:end`, the `junction_key`) instead.

```{r load_coloc}
coloc_raw <- read_csv(F_COLOC_WITH_SLOPES, show_col_types = FALSE)

coloc <- coloc_raw %>%
  separate(cluster_id,
           into = c("chr_num", "intron_start", "intron_end", "cluster", "gene_id"),
           sep = ":", remove = FALSE, extra = "merge", fill = "right") %>%
  mutate(
    intron_start  = as.numeric(intron_start),
    intron_end    = as.numeric(intron_end),
    chr_junc      = ifelse(grepl("^chr", chr_num), chr_num, paste0("chr", chr_num)),
    gene_id_clean = str_remove(gene_id, "\\.\\d+$"),
    junction_key  = paste(chr_junc, intron_start, intron_end, sep = ":"),
    gene_name     = sGene
  )

stopifnot(!any(is.na(coloc$intron_start)), !any(is.na(coloc$intron_end)))
cat(sprintf("%d junction x condition rows; %d distinct junctions; %d sGenes\n",
            nrow(coloc), n_distinct(coloc$junction_key), n_distinct(coloc$gene_name)))
```

# 2. Effect direction relative to the CAD risk allele

The sQTL slope is the per-alternative-allele effect on junction usage. The GWAS risk allele is
the effect allele when the GWAS beta is positive and the other allele when it is negative; the
slope sign is kept when the risk allele is the alternative allele and inverted when it is the
reference allele. Alleles are also compared to their reverse complements so that strand
differences between the two resources do not leave a variant unresolved. Where several rows
exist for one rsID, the most significant GWAS association is used.

```{r correct_effect_direction}
aragam <- read_tsv(F_ARAGAM_SNP_SUBSET, show_col_types = FALSE)

aragam_risk <- aragam %>%
  filter(!is.na(rsid), !is.na(beta)) %>%
  mutate(
    gwas_risk_allele       = toupper(ifelse(beta > 0, effect_allele, other_allele)),
    gwas_protective_allele = toupper(ifelse(beta > 0, other_allele, effect_allele)),
    gwas_beta              = beta,
    gwas_or                = odds_ratio) %>%
  group_by(rsid) %>%
  slice_min(p_value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(rsid, gwas_risk_allele, gwas_protective_allele, gwas_beta, gwas_or, gwas_p = p_value)

revcomp_base <- function(b) {
  b <- toupper(b)
  dplyr::recode(b, A = "T", T = "A", C = "G", G = "C", .default = NA_character_)
}

# Returns the direction of the risk-allele effect on junction usage ("Increased" /
# "Decreased" / NA) and a status flag recording how the risk allele was matched.
compute_effect_direction <- function(slope, ref, alt, risk_allele) {
  if (is.na(slope) || is.na(risk_allele) || is.na(ref) || is.na(alt))
    return(c(dir = NA_character_, status = "missing_input"))
  ref <- toupper(ref); alt <- toupper(alt); ra <- toupper(risk_allele)

  if (ra == alt) {
    return(c(dir = ifelse(slope > 0, "Increased", "Decreased"), status = "risk_is_alt"))
  } else if (ra == ref) {
    return(c(dir = ifelse(slope > 0, "Decreased", "Increased"), status = "risk_is_ref"))
  }

  # Strand-flip fallback: compare against the reverse complement of the risk allele.
  ra_rc <- revcomp_base(ra)
  if (!is.na(ra_rc)) {
    if (ra_rc == alt) {
      return(c(dir = ifelse(slope > 0, "Increased", "Decreased"), status = "risk_is_alt_strandflip"))
    } else if (ra_rc == ref) {
      return(c(dir = ifelse(slope > 0, "Decreased", "Increased"), status = "risk_is_ref_strandflip"))
    }
  }
  c(dir = NA_character_, status = "allele_mismatch")
}

coloc <- coloc %>% left_join(aragam_risk, by = "rsid")

ed <- mapply(compute_effect_direction,
             coloc$slope, coloc$ref, coloc$alt, coloc$gwas_risk_allele, SIMPLIFY = TRUE)

coloc <- coloc %>%
  mutate(
    effect_direction_old     = effect_direction,   # slope-sign-only direction, kept for reference
    effect_direction         = ed["dir", ],         # direction relative to the CAD risk allele
    risk_allele_status       = ed["status", ],
    effect_direction_verbose = case_when(
      effect_direction == "Increased" ~ "Increased Expression with Risk Allele",
      effect_direction == "Decreased" ~ "Decreased Expression with Risk Allele",
      TRUE                            ~ NA_character_)
  )

cat("Risk-allele resolution status:\n")
print(count(coloc, risk_allele_status))
```

## 2b. LD-proxy lookup for unresolved lead variants

Lead variants absent from the GWAS summary statistics are looked up through their LD proxies
(r² ≥ 0.8); the proxy with the most significant GWAS association is retained. Because the proxy
risk allele is defined on the proxy's own reference/alternative alleles and its phase with the
lead variant is not known from these tables, the proxy information is attached to the table for
inspection rather than used to assign `effect_direction` automatically.

```{r ld_proxy_fallback}
unresolved_rsids <- coloc %>% filter(is.na(gwas_risk_allele)) %>% pull(rsid) %>% unique()

if (length(unresolved_rsids) > 0) {
  snp_ld <- read_csv(F_CAD_SQTL_SNPS_LD, show_col_types = FALSE)
  names(snp_ld)[1] <- "proxy_snp"

  proxy_lookup <- snp_ld %>%
    filter(query_lead_snp_rsid %in% unresolved_rsids, proxy_snp %in% aragam_risk$rsid) %>%
    left_join(aragam_risk, by = c("proxy_snp" = "rsid")) %>%
    group_by(query_lead_snp_rsid) %>%
    slice_min(gwas_p, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(query_lead_snp_rsid, proxy_snp,
           proxy_risk_allele = gwas_risk_allele, proxy_gwas_p = gwas_p)

  if (nrow(proxy_lookup) > 0) {
    coloc <- coloc %>% left_join(proxy_lookup, by = c("rsid" = "query_lead_snp_rsid"))
  }
  cat(sprintf("%d of %d unresolved lead variants have an LD proxy in the GWAS table\n",
              nrow(proxy_lookup), length(unresolved_rsids)))
}
```

# 3. Intron sets of the long-read and GENCODE v38 transcripts

Transcript identifiers in the long-read intron table have the form `GENE|PB.x.y|N`; the PacBio
accession is extracted with an explicit pattern so that, for example, `PB.6545.1` is never
matched as a prefix of `PB.6545.10`. Isoforms are collapsed to one row per junction so that the
join to the colocalization table adds a comma-separated isoform list rather than duplicating
junction rows.

```{r load_lr_introns}
intron_lr <- read_tsv(F_SMC_INTRON_COORDS, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    gene_id_clean = str_remove(gene_id, "\\.\\d+$"),
    pb_acc        = str_extract(trans_id, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"),
    junction_key  = paste(chr, intron_start, intron_end, sep = ":")
  )

lr_junc_isoforms <- intron_lr %>%
  group_by(chr, intron_start, intron_end, gene_id, gene_id_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    smc_isoforms   = paste(unique(trans_id), collapse = ","),
    pb_gene_id     = dplyr::first(na.omit(str_extract(trans_id, "PB\\.[0-9]+"))),
    n_smc_isoforms = n_distinct(trans_id),
    strand         = dplyr::first(strand),
    junc_id        = dplyr::first(junc_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(junction_key = paste(chr, intron_start, intron_end, sep = ":"))

cat(sprintf("%d long-read junction-gene pairs across %d isoforms\n",
            nrow(lr_junc_isoforms), n_distinct(intron_lr$pb_acc)))
```

```{r load_gencode}
gencode_lr <- read_tsv(F_GENCODE_V38_INTRONS, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = str_remove(gene_id, "\\.\\d+$"))

gc_junc_isoforms <- gencode_lr %>%
  group_by(chr, intron_start, intron_end, gene_id_clean) %>%
  summarise(gencode_v38_isoforms = paste(unique(gencode_v38_isoforms), collapse = ","),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(junction_key = paste(chr, intron_start, intron_end, sep = ":"))

cat(sprintf("%d GENCODE v38 junction-gene pairs\n", nrow(gc_junc_isoforms)))
```

# 4. Integrated junction table

Both joins are by exact intron coordinates, which is the matching rule stated in Methods. The
column order of the exported table is fixed because downstream scripts and the junction master
table in script 10 address these columns by name.

```{r integrate}
lfc_integrated <- coloc %>%
  left_join(lr_junc_isoforms %>%
              select(junction_key, pb_gene_id, smc_isoforms, n_smc_isoforms, strand, junc_id),
            by = "junction_key") %>%
  left_join(gc_junc_isoforms %>% select(junction_key, gencode_v38_isoforms),
            by = "junction_key")

lfc_final <- lfc_integrated %>%
  select(
    chr = chr_junc, intron_start, intron_end, pb_gene_id,
    gene_id = gene_id_clean, gene_name,
    smc_isoforms, gencode_v38_isoforms, cluster,
    SNP_ID = rsid, sQTL_pval_nominal, sQTL_pval_nominal_threshold, sQTL_qval,
    pos, ref, alt, MAF, Condition, strand, junc_id, junction_key,
    slope, slope_se,
    effect_direction, effect_direction_old, effect_direction_verbose,
    gwas_risk_allele, gwas_protective_allele, gwas_beta, gwas_or, risk_allele_status,
    tensorqtl_pval, tensorqtl_qval
  )
```

```{r summary}
n_total   <- n_distinct(lfc_final$junction_key)
n_smc     <- lfc_final %>% filter(!is.na(smc_isoforms)) %>% pull(junction_key) %>% n_distinct()
n_gc      <- lfc_final %>% filter(!is.na(gencode_v38_isoforms)) %>% pull(junction_key) %>% n_distinct()
n_both    <- lfc_final %>% filter(!is.na(smc_isoforms), !is.na(gencode_v38_isoforms)) %>%
  pull(junction_key) %>% n_distinct()
n_neither <- lfc_final %>% filter(is.na(smc_isoforms), is.na(gencode_v38_isoforms)) %>%
  pull(junction_key) %>% n_distinct()

cat(sprintf(paste0("Distinct junctions: %d\n  in long-read transcripts: %d\n",
                   "  in GENCODE v38: %d\n  in both: %d\n  in neither: %d\n"),
            n_total, n_smc, n_gc, n_both, n_neither))
```

```{r export}
write_tsv(lfc_final, OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED)
cat(sprintf("Wrote %s (%d rows)\n", basename(OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED), nrow(lfc_final)))
```

# 5. Colocalization, LD-expansion and annotation counts

The counts quoted in Results and Methods are computed from the Supplementary Tables workbook
rather than from intermediate files, so that every reported number can be traced to a published
table. Junctions are keyed on `chr:start:end` for the reason given in Section 1, and the two
conditions are never summed because 110 junctions are colocalized in both.

```{r coloc_numbers_setup}
coord_key <- function(df) {
  p <- stringr::str_split_fixed(df$cluster_id, ":", 4)
  paste(p[, 1], p[, 2], p[, 3], sep = ":")
}
mk_keys <- function(df) {
  names(df)[names(df) == "rsid (lead sQTL SNP)"] <- "lead_rsid"
  names(df)[names(df) == "Phenotype"]            <- "Condition"
  df$coord <- coord_key(df)
  df$gc    <- paste(df$sGene, df$Condition, sep = "|")
  df
}

s1 <- read_excel(F_SUPP_TABLES_XLSX, sheet = "S1-new coloc results")       %>% mk_keys()
s2 <- read_excel(F_SUPP_TABLES_XLSX, sheet = "S2-Aggregate coloc results") %>% mk_keys()
```

```{r coloc_numbers}
n_junc      <- n_distinct(s2$coord)       # distinct colocalized junctions
n_junc_cond <- nrow(s2)                   # junction x condition observations
n_sgenes    <- n_distinct(s2$sGene)       # sGene labels (comma-joined multi-gene labels kept intact)
n_lead_snps <- n_distinct(s2$lead_rsid)   # lead sQTL variants

jq <- unique(s2$coord[s2$Condition == "Quiescent"])
jp <- unique(s2$coord[s2$Condition == "Proliferative"])
gq <- unique(s2$sGene[s2$Condition == "Quiescent"])
gp <- unique(s2$sGene[s2$Condition == "Proliferative"])

stopifnot(n_junc == 355, n_sgenes == 168, n_lead_snps == 304)
cat(sprintf("%d distinct junctions (%d junction x condition rows); %d sGenes; %d lead variants\n",
            n_junc, n_junc_cond, n_sgenes, n_lead_snps))
```

## 5b. LD expansion and overlap with CAD GWAS variants

Sheet S3 lists the lead sQTL variants with their LD proxies (columns 1–2) and the CAD GWAS lead
variants with theirs (columns 3–4); the variants shared between the two LD-expanded sets are the
1,534 variants submitted to VEP and SpliceAI (Fig. 1f), and sheet S4 is the published listing of
that same set.

```{r ld_expansion}
s3 <- read_excel(F_SUPP_TABLES_XLSX, sheet = "S3-LD snp list", skip = 1)
lead_all <- unique(na.omit(s3[[1]]))
ld_all   <- unique(na.omit(s3[[2]]))
cad_ld   <- unique(na.omit(s3[[4]]))
overlap  <- intersect(ld_all, cad_ld)

s4      <- read_excel(F_SUPP_TABLES_XLSX, sheet = "S4-CAD_sQTL SNP overlap")
s4_snps <- unique(na.omit(s4[[1]]))
stopifnot(identical(sort(s4_snps), sort(overlap)))
n_sgenes_shared <- n_distinct(na.omit(s4[[7]]))

cat(sprintf("lead variants %d; LD r2 >= 0.8 variants %d; CAD GWAS LD variants %d; shared %d\n",
            length(lead_all), length(ld_all), length(cad_ld), length(overlap)))
```

## 5c. VEP and SpliceAI annotation

All shared variants were annotated; sheet S5 lists only those with a non-zero SpliceAI score or
a splicing-related VEP consequence, so the denominator for every proportion is the number of
submitted variants. SpliceAI reports four delta scores per variant (acceptor/donor gain/loss) and
one row per affected transcript; the maximum delta across scores and rows is taken as the
variant's score, and a variant counts as having a splicing VEP consequence if any transcript
annotation carries one of the splice-site or splice-region terms.

```{r vep_spliceai_annotation}
s5 <- read_excel(F_SUPP_TABLES_XLSX, sheet = "S5-SpliceAI & VEP all data")
score_cols <- c("Acceptor Gain SpliceAI Score", "Acceptor Loss SpliceAI Score",
                "Donor Gain SpliceAI Score",    "Donor Loss SpliceAI Score")
stopifnot(all(score_cols %in% names(s5)))

s5 <- s5 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(score_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ifelse(. == "-", NA, .)))))

splice_terms <- c("splice_acceptor_variant", "splice_donor_variant",
                  "splice_region_variant", "splice_donor_5th_base_variant",
                  "splice_donor_region_variant", "splice_polypyrimidine_tract_variant")

per_variant <- s5 %>%
  group_by(rsID) %>%
  summarise(
    max_delta = suppressWarnings(max(
      c(.data[[score_cols[1]]], .data[[score_cols[2]]],
        .data[[score_cols[3]]], .data[[score_cols[4]]]), na.rm = TRUE)),
    consequences = paste(unique(unlist(strsplit(paste(Consequence, collapse = ","), ","))),
                         collapse = ","),
    n_rows = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(max_delta = ifelse(is.finite(max_delta), max_delta, NA_real_),
         has_splice_vep = purrr::map_lgl(consequences,
                                         ~ any(splice_terms %in% trimws(strsplit(.x, ",")[[1]]))))

n_submitted  <- length(overlap)
n_in_s5      <- nrow(per_variant)
n_scored     <- sum(!is.na(per_variant$max_delta))
n_nonzero    <- sum(per_variant$max_delta > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_ge02       <- sum(per_variant$max_delta >= 0.2, na.rm = TRUE)
n_ge05       <- sum(per_variant$max_delta >= 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)
n_splice_vep <- sum(per_variant$has_splice_vep)
n_either     <- sum(per_variant$has_splice_vep |
                      (per_variant$max_delta >= 0.2 & !is.na(per_variant$max_delta)))

cat(sprintf("%d of %d submitted variants returned splicing evidence; %d with SpliceAI >= 0.2\n",
            n_in_s5, n_submitted, n_ge02))

readr::write_excel_csv(per_variant, OUT_VARIANT_VEP_SPLICEAI)
```

## 5d. Summary table of reported numbers

```{r number_summary}
pct <- function(x, d = n_submitted, dp = 2) {
  sprintf(paste0("%.", dp, "f%% of %s submitted"), 100 * x / d, format(d, big.mark = ","))
}

coloc_numbers <- tibble::tribble(
  ~step, ~quantity, ~n, ~source, ~note,
  "Colocalization", "Colocalized junctions (distinct)",  n_junc,
    "S2", "Coordinate level (chr:start:end)",
  "Colocalization", "Junction x condition observations", n_junc_cond,
    "S2", sprintf("%d junctions colocalized in both conditions", length(intersect(jq, jp))),
  "Colocalization", "Colocalized sGenes",                n_sgenes,
    "S2", "Labels as reported; multi-gene labels kept intact",
  "Colocalization", "Lead sQTL variants",                n_lead_snps,
    "S2", "Distinct rsIDs across both conditions",
  "Colocalization", "Junctions, quiescent",              length(jq), "S2", "",
  "Colocalization", "Junctions, proliferative",          length(jp), "S2", "",
  "Colocalization", "Junctions in both conditions",      length(intersect(jq, jp)),
    "S2", "The union is the total; conditions are not summed",
  "Colocalization", "sGenes, quiescent",                 length(gq), "S2", "",
  "Colocalization", "sGenes, proliferative",             length(gp), "S2", "",
  "Colocalization", "sGenes in both conditions",         length(intersect(gq, gp)), "S2", "",

  "Updated colocalization", "Junctions in the updated run", n_distinct(s1$coord),
    "S1", "Subset of S2 at the coordinate level",
  "Updated colocalization", "sGenes in the updated run",    n_distinct(s1$sGene), "S1", "",

  "LD expansion", "Lead variants entering LD expansion", length(lead_all), "S3", "",
  "LD expansion", "Variants in LD r2 >= 0.8",           length(ld_all),   "S3", "",
  "LD expansion", "CAD GWAS LD-expanded variants",      length(cad_ld),   "S3", "",
  "LD expansion", "Shared sQTL + CAD variants",         length(overlap),
    "S3 / S4", "Fig. 1f endpoint; the set annotated with VEP and SpliceAI",
  "LD expansion", "sGenes among shared variants",       n_sgenes_shared,  "S4", "",

  "Annotation", "Variants submitted to VEP + SpliceAI", n_submitted,
    "S3 / S4", "Denominator for all annotation proportions",
  "Annotation", "Returned any splicing evidence",       n_in_s5,
    "S5", "Non-zero SpliceAI score or splicing VEP consequence",
  "Annotation", "Scored by SpliceAI",                   n_scored,  "S5", "",
  "Annotation", "Non-zero SpliceAI score",              n_nonzero, "S5", "",
  "Annotation", "SpliceAI >= 0.2",                      n_ge02,    "S5", pct(n_ge02),
  "Annotation", "SpliceAI >= 0.5",                      n_ge05,    "S5", "",
  "Annotation", "SpliceAI < 0.2",                       n_submitted - n_ge02, "S5", "",
  "Annotation", "Splicing VEP consequence",             n_splice_vep,
    "S5", "Unique variants, not annotation count",
  "Annotation", "Prioritized (either criterion)",       n_either,  "S5", pct(n_either)
) %>% mutate(n = as.integer(n))

readr::write_excel_csv(coloc_numbers, OUT_COLOC_NUMBER_SUMMARY)
knitr::kable(coloc_numbers, format = "simple")
```
